claims.evidence: Units are wrapped in plastic film; lens surfaces, scratches, fogging or cracks cannot be assessed from the photo.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy
claims.evidence: No branding, logo, or model text visible on the housings or packaging per the witness report.
Plastic wrap obscures the lens surface; a crack could be hidden by the film or glare.
Mounting hardware and connectors are listed as not shown in the report.

risks.risk: Vehicle fitment (make/model/year) unknown, so compatibility cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Close-up of any embossed part number or OEM sticker on the housing, or a shot matching the connector shape to a known model
risks.if_unproven: price as generic/unverified-fitment unit, not as a confirmed-model OEM part

risks.risk: Authenticity (OEM vs aftermarket/replica) cannot be confirmed from a wrapped, unbranded unit
risks.proof: Unwrapped close-up of embossed Toyota logo/part number on the lens or housing
risks.if_unproven: price as unverified aftermarket, not as confirmed genuine Toyota OEM

risks.risk: Internal bulb, wiring, and electrical function unknown
risks.proof: Short clip of the lights powered on showing both low and high beam working
risks.if_unproven: price as non-tested electrical condition (worst case: non-functional)

risks.risk: Hidden lens cracks, cloudiness, or moisture ingress under the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photo with plastic wrap removed, lens unobstructed, under good light
risks.if_unproven: price as condition unverified, treat as possibly damaged

risks.risk: Completeness of clips, brackets, and connectors not actually visible
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear housing showing all clips, brackets, and wiring connectors
risks.if_unproven: price as incomplete/unknown hardware until shown

proof_requests: Unwrap one unit and photograph the lens and housing closely, including any embossed logo or part number
Short video of both headlights powered on (low and high beam)
Close-up of the rear connector and mounting brackets/clips
Any photo showing a part number plate or sticker, if present
response.reason: The witness confirms a pair of car headlight assemblies, so they can be priced at worst case as unverified-fitment, unverified-authenticity, unverified-condition units; seller's claims of Toyota-original and flawless condition are unproven and cannot be confirmed remotely from a plastic-wrapped, unbranded item.
